items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: I played a parade with George Williams across the river... I played some parades with George Williams.

ctx.x: Did you find it hard to play?

Well, no, the playing wasn't that hard, but it's the walking, man. Then we had to walk on those rocks and those shells, you know, and across the river. I mean, how those cemeteries were. Oh, you fall away, you know? And those guys, I mean, well, they get a kick out of that, damn. See? But, I mean, you got to walk and play at the same time. Well, they're used to walking on those rocks. We're not used to that, you know? We walk on the sidewalk and the pavement, some of it is brick and all that, but after all, I…
Sure, yeah, he and I played it together.
